title: Advanced Paste can leave Shift stuck with Caps Lock → Ctrl remap
author: jincechen

status.label: Duplicate modifier-release bug
status.detail: Maintainers have consolidated Advanced Paste modifier keys remaining logically pressed under open issue #27612.

next_action.label: Post duplicate response
next_action.reason: Move the useful Caps Lock-to-Ctrl interaction evidence to #27612 instead of opening a parallel fix track.

judgment.rationale: The symptom and recovery are the same modifier-release failure that maintainers used #27612 to consolidate across #42471, #43220, #38028, #45685, and #46874; this issue adds a valuable Keyboard Manager remap variant.
evidence: Shift remains logically pressed after Advanced Paste and is released by pressing the modifier combination again.
The problem disappears when Advanced Paste is disabled while the Caps Lock → Ctrl remap remains enabled.
Maintainers closed multiple matching Advanced Paste stuck-modifier reports as duplicates of #27612.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate response linking #27612 and explicitly ask that the Caps Lock → Ctrl interaction remain as additional reproduction evidence there.

issue_context.summary: Using Advanced Paste through a Caps Lock → Ctrl remap can intermittently leave Shift logically held, affecting taskbar clicks and text selection until the modifier combination is pressed again.
known_information: The physical sequence is Caps Lock + Shift + V, transformed into Ctrl + Shift + V by Keyboard Manager.
Disabling Advanced Paste while keeping the remap removes the symptom.
Several earlier Advanced Paste reports describe Ctrl/Shift/Win remaining pressed and were consolidated by maintainers under #27612.
inferences: The remapped modifier path may expose the same release/restore weakness through a different physical-key state, but it does not yet establish a distinct root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The report is specific and useful, but maintainer history shows that the product treats this symptom family as one canonical bug. Consolidation preserves the new remap evidence without duplicating engineering work.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue, related links, triage comment, and duplicate-digest reference.
Read maintainer closure comments on #42471, #43220, #38028, #45685, and #46874; each points to #27612 for stuck modifiers after Advanced Paste.
Inspected AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp, where held modifiers are released before injected copy/paste and then restored with SendInput, matching the affected behavior boundary.

actions.label: Post duplicate response

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed Caps Lock → Ctrl reproduction and for confirming that disabling Advanced Paste removes the problem. PowerToys maintainers are consolidating Advanced Paste cases where Ctrl/Shift/Win remain logically pressed under #27612; #42471, #43220, #38028, #45685, and #46874 were closed into that tracker. This issue should be closed as a duplicate of #27612, with the Keyboard Manager remap sequence retained there as useful additional reproduction evidence.
